notes: Tata CLiQ Luxury (luxury.tatacliq.com), Home department (category code LSH14) scoped per marketplace discipline. robots.txt: ClaudeBot has an explicit empty Disallow (fully allowed), so Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch was used throughout, no WAF/bypass needed. Checked: (1) homepage CMS nav config embedded in SSR HTML (Contentful 'Luxury Navigation Menu' block) - only contains a Luxe/Indi store switcher, brand-logo strip, cart/profile/search icons; no Bestsellers/Popular/Trending/Top Sellers tab or link anywhere, confirmed by a 0-hit scan of the full homepage HTML for 'Best Seller'/'Bestseller'/footer links. (2) Full prior-pass LSH14 taxonomy enumeration (Lighting, Home Decor & Accessories, Candles & Candle Holders, Bathroom Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Health & Fitness, Home Furnishing, Storage, Bed, Home Essentials - 10 L2 branches) contains no Bestsellers/Popular/Trending branch. (3) Sort options on a live Home PLP (https://luxury.tatacliq.com/luxury-home/c-lsh14?q=:relevance:category:LSH14) are only: relevance ('Popularity', the default, selected sort - not a distinct bestseller subset), isProductNew ('New Arrivals'), isDiscountedPrice ('Discounts'), price-asc, price-desc - none of these isolate a best-selling subset; 'Popularity' is just the default relevance ranking applied to the full 24776-item department listing, not a separate count. (4) Guessed candidate slugs /best-sellers and /bestsellers both returned the generic SPA app-shell (byte-identical in structure to a bad route - no totalResults/product-grid JSON, unlike real category pages which embed full SSR product-search JSON), indicating these are not real backend routes. (5) Site search (q=bestseller, scoped to category:LSH14) returned totalResults:0 - zero products even match the keyword, let alone a curated listing. No genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists for this site's Home department.
